documentsRequired: As required on the official portal
title: Bihar Income, Cast, Residential Certificate Online Apply & Verification 2026
postName: Income / Caste / Residence Certificate – RTPS Online Services
vacancyDetails: Online apply and status/verification for Bihar Income, Caste and Residential certificates
howToApply:
1. Visit https://serviceonline.bihar.gov.in or RTPS Bihar portal
2. Select Revenue / Certificate services
3. Apply for Income / Caste / Residence certificate
4. Upload documents and pay fee if any
5. Download issued certificate and verify online
shortDescription: Bihar Income, Caste, Residential Certificate online apply and verification 2026 on serviceonline.bihar.gov.in.
content:
Citizens of Bihar can apply for Income, Caste and Residential certificates through the state online service delivery system (ServicePlus / RTPS).

Portal: serviceonline.bihar.gov.in. Track application status and download digitally signed certificates. These documents are required for scholarships, jobs and admissions.
